links.outcome: Readability (FKGL and FRE) of chatbot responses to dental trauma queries
links.effect: Mean FKGL/FRE: ChatGPT 3.5 11.2/49.25, ChatGPT 4.0 11.8/46.42, Gemini 10.1/51.91; responses difficult to read, requiring college-level reading ability.
links.quote: The mean FKGL and FRE scores for ChatGPT 3.5, ChatGPT 4.0, and Google Gemini were 11.2 and 49.25, 11.8 and 46.42, and 10.1 and 51.91, respectively, indicating that the responses were difficult to read and required a college-level reading ability.

screen.reason: Evaluates readability, quality, and accuracy of AI chatbots answering patient queries on traumatic dental injuries without testing specific organizational deployment safeguards or practices.
